{{Quote|All of the village's children knew her as the storyteller. On hot summer evenings, we'd gather under the takka trees to hear her tell tales of grand adventures and brave heroes.|Ana Tathis, on Lady Caryn|<ref name="RPG" />}}
The '''takka tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew in the vicinity of a [[Unidentified village (Ana Tathis)|village]] at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. On [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] [[Summer/Legends|summer]] [[Local day/Legends|evenings]], the children of the settlement, including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ana Tathis]], gathered under the trees in order to listen to tales told by the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] known as [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Caryn (Jedi)|Caryn]], who maintained vast tropical [[Garden/Legends|gardens]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Tathis recounted the gathering of the village's children under the takka trees.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The takka tree was mentioned in [[Bill Smith]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' [[1996]] core rulebook of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RPG" />
